verdict.rationale: Ramp documents its own data-access paths. Admins can "pull full spend exports" via MCP or the CLI, the open-source CLI emits JSON in agent mode, the REST API retrieves transaction data, and accounting integrations sync transactions, reimbursements and bills out to QuickBooks, NetSuite and Xero. However, nothing documents a complete account-wide export or an offboarding path. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export of all account data (receipts, cards, users, policies, audit logs) in open formats, an explicit data-portability or account-exit process, and independent hands-on corroboration of a full export.
